title: Playbook TradingAgents verdicts — 2026-11-03
summary: TradingAgents (market analyst only, DeepSeek, one debate round) returned Hold on Hensoldt for 2026-11-03: the primary uptrend is intact at €85.62, but leading momentum is fading — seven straight sessions of a shrinking MACD histogram, retest volume at roughly half the breakout day, and price only 0.8% above the VWMA. With ~7% risk to the €79.60 structural stop against a 6.6% first target at €91.26, the setup is about 1:1, so the plan keeps the current weight as a ceiling, adds nothing at market, and acts only on confirmation. That is partial agreement with the playbook's BUY LIST stance — hold, do not chase, and buy only the ladder.

rows: Hold at €85.62 at no more than the current weight — no new money until two closes above €87.90 on >300k shares (adds capped at ~one-third of a full position) or the €82.8–83.0 / €81.2 dip zone prints; hard structural stop €79.60, just under the rising 200-SMA (€79.67).

sections.heading: How the agent reasoned
sections.body: The market analyst found the trend unbroken but the tape tiring: price sits above the 10-EMA, 50-SMA and a rising 200-SMA (€79.67), the 20-SMA is climbing from €77.27 to €82.84, RSI ~57 is not overbought, and the MACD line (1.84) is still above signal (1.47). Against that, the MACD histogram has fallen seven consecutive sessions from 1.39 to 0.37 (−73%) after a +17.6% run in eight sessions, the 16–19 October closes above the €91.26 upper band failed to hold, and the 30 October down day closed at €85.62 near its low (€84.96) on 202k shares while retest volume runs at roughly half the 420k breakout day — turnover without upward progress. The bull/bear judge rejected both the aggressive 'healthy consolidation, buy the dip' framing and the conservative 'trim now' prescription: risk to invalidation (~7.0%) versus the first target (~6.6%, and that target needs an unconfirmed, volume-absent breakout through €87.90 and €89.20) is roughly 1:1, while trimming 5.5% above the 50-SMA right on a rising 20-SMA is selling into support. The risk round converged on the neutral read — intact trend argues against exiting, fading momentum argues against adding — and the trader formalized it as Hold with explicit ladders on both sides and a stop tied to structure rather than a bare price.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.body: Market analyst only — no news, fundamentals or social agents; DeepSeek chat models via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; one debate round and one risk round, so this is a shallow pass by design. LLM output can misstate numbers: verify every price level against the chart before acting. The BUY LIST → Agree/Partial/Disagree mapping is the routine's own scale, not something TradingAgents outputs.
